literal_meaning: ঘটনাস্থলে স্থানীয় তদন্ত (on-site or spot investigation)
figurative_meaning_en: Investigation conducted at the scene of the incident
example_sentences_in_bangla: পুলিশ ঘটনাস্থলে সরেজমিন তদন্ত শুরু করেছে।
সাংবাদিকরা সরেজমিন তদন্ত করে সত্য তথ্য সংগ্রহ করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The police have begun an on-site investigation at the scene.
The journalists gathered facts through an on-site investigation.
note: This idiom is commonly used in formal and legal contexts in Bengali, emphasizing direct observation over hearsay.
